daPeach_c declares its destructor inside the class body, so mwccarm emits D1 at 0x02129d18 and D0 at 0x02129d60 from PeachDemandCompleteDtor (a destructor call) and PeachDemandDeletingDtor (a delete-expression). Those two functions are non-static: a static demand leaves a size-0 STB_LOCAL after its section is dropped, and promotion refuses that. Nothing references them, so the link removes the symbols. They are not in the ROM. include/daPeach_c.h is unchanged.

func_ov085_02129f8c used to call a file-static normalize, and that call is the only relocated word besides FindWithID. The cartridge has cmp r0, #0 at +0x40 (e3500000), not a BL. Returning through both arms of `if (r == 0) goto done` keeps the compare and the 0x50-byte body. tubuild verify is 25/25 MATCH, and that word is the compare in the object. The promoted delink is one complete span, so dsd no longer serves this function from ROM bytes.

Ownership: ov085 .init, .ctor and .bss run in .text TU order; d_a_peach follows d_a_kinopio in .text, this initializer follows kinopio's, its .ctor word 0x0212fdf4 sits between kinopio's and d_a_mip's, its .bss 0x021304bc..0x021305ac runs from kinopio's end to mip's start, and the literals name only this TU's state handlers. The same change licenses the TU's whole .data run 0x0212ff34..0x0213003c (PMF literals, _ZTS/_ZTI, the new typed g_profile_PEACH_PRINCESS and the vtable, whose 0x84-byte storage starts at 0x0212ffb8, two words ahead of the configured address point) and makes the TU intact-object.
